decisions.reason: The multi-model aloe vera line with its own dedicated page remains the firm's most visible and heavily invested facial care commitment, so management persists with it and attributes any softness to its still-early market phase.

The hyaluronic serum fits the core facial care range and costs little to sustain in small batches, so it is kept, though its modest visibility leaves it more exposed than the line, especially after the firm already pruned the cleansing milk.

The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and partly replaces the withdrawn cleansing milk in the cleansing segment, so management wants to justify that recent decision and give it time before judging results.
